That is insufficient to apply the rectangular-product estimate to the fourth term as written: the dot there is the level-n multiplication obtained by amplifying the compressed product on S_P, whereas lem-compcb-rectangular-product bounds the product defined inside M_n tensor A by A dot_rect B=Co_{P_n}(AB). Equality of the underlying corner spaces does not identify these two bilinear products. One must explicitly use 1_{M_n} tensor Co_P=Co_{P_n}, linearity, and the matrix-product formula to prove (A dot_{M_n tensor S_P} B)=Co_{P_n}(AB). Without that missing product-naturality step, the cited external may be estimating a different term.
